decision.current_action: Do not promote this static vector to T2, T3, T4 or an allocation instruction. Continue with a frozen rulebook, structure-specific dossiers and licensed or authoritative point-in-time total-return evidence.
reason: The price-only diagnostic has complete rolling five-year windows below 5%, so even this weaker proxy does not clear the all-window threshold.
Unadjusted price observations omit or leave ambiguous distributions and corporate actions; they are not a total-return ledger.
Costs, taxes, execution, point-in-time universe membership and liquidity constraints are absent.

purpose: A frozen public price-only diagnostic that tests whether a simple, predeclared static cross-asset screen can support the existing 5% total-return research objective. It cannot do so.

rolling_five_year_price_diagnostic.overlapping_windows_warning: These daily-end windows overlap extensively and are not independent samples.

rulebook.distribution_treatment: not modelled; no distribution is added to or inferred from the price series
rulebook.execution: no fill, lot, settlement, spread, market-impact, suspension or price-limit assertion
rulebook.rebalancing_mark: first common price observation of each calendar quarter; the unitized calculation applies the marked weight only to the following price interval
rulebook.weighting: equal 25% target weight per screened ETF

screening_universe.label: SSE Dividend equity ETF price sleeve

universe_boundary: This finite four-ETF screening set is not a dated T2 decision universe, does not permanently exclude direct equities, REITs, sovereign instruments or other lawful products, and does not admit any instrument to T3 or T4.
warnings: A favorable full-window annualized price result is not a forecast, probability estimate, return floor or guarantee.
Do not combine this price series with fund distributions or NAV returns without a single source-consistent total-return convention; that would risk double counting.
The set deliberately excludes no asset class permanently. It is a limited discovery screen only.
No cash-receipt objective or automatic reinvestment is used in this diagnostic.
